title: 第10章 去小羊山开荒
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: “来，吃个橙子。”王爱棉拿了一个绿皮的橙子递给徐喜弟。“还没到熟的时候，但也能吃了，我们年轻人都爱这一口，我从树上摘了一小袋。”徐喜弟也没客气接过来，上手就剥，等她刚剥好，却冷不丁被刘宇宁抢了去。“我没指甲，不好剥，这个给我先尝尝。”徐喜弟愣了一下，然后恼怒地瞪了他一眼，“你也知道皮硬不好剥，抢我的！”呵呵呵……几个年轻人，笑成一片，好不欢乐。王爱棉又递了一个上去，“还有还有，别急……”王秀菊在火房和堂屋之间，来来回回穿行，目光始终看向快贴在一起的两道身影。在第八次来回后，她终于找到了合适的由头，“宇宁，我看见你妹带着你外甥走到村口了，快去接一下。”刘宇宁一听说妹妹回来了，还带着小外甥，连忙站起来，“到了吗？”徐喜弟看时间差不多，再不走人家就要吃午饭了，她也站起来，拉着巴儿姐。“宇宁哥，我也该回去做午饭了。爱棉，你等会儿有空上我家来坐坐。”“好，吃了午饭就过去。”王爱棉也跟着站起身，要给徐喜弟送行，嘴边还是客气地挽留一下，“要不一起吃了午饭再回去呗？”“不了不了，家里长辈还等着，他们不知道。”徐喜弟可不敢留下吃饭，王秀菊脸都黑成啥样了。巴儿姐却僵着身子不肯动，目光灼灼盯着那一担三色糯米饭看。徐喜弟尴尬得老脸一红，大姑姐这个丢人的举动，让她有些无地自容。王爱棉也看得出来巴儿姐想吃糯米饭，可是东西送进姑姑家，就不是她能开口随意分配的了。王秀菊嘴角抽了抽，娘家人挑担进门，当着他们的面，她也不好直接就去挖一块出来。客人没走，礼不能动，这是规矩。王爱棉只好又抓了几颗糖，拿了两个橙子塞给巴儿姐，来缓解这个尴尬的场面。可巴儿姐就是拧巴，她就想吃糯米饭，手里拿着糖果，脚还是挪不动。最后是刘宇宁，去担上揪了一大团糯米饭，交到徐喜弟手上。“看着怪好吃的，带回去尝尝。”徐喜弟的老脸已经红到了耳朵根，早知道她就不来这一趟，丢死个人！但她也只能硬着头皮接过来，有了它，巴儿姐立刻就眉开眼笑，蹦蹦跳跳跟着她回院回家。……逃一样离开刘家，徐喜弟看着手里捧的一大团糯米饭，真想扔到草丛里去。可她不能，一来不能浪费粮食，二来巴儿姐肯定得折返，再回去要一团。回家路上，经过一个岔路口，刘烨扛着一个把踩梨，还有一个钉锄，腰间还别着一把大柴刀正要出村。看到徐喜弟和巴儿姐，他停下脚步，远远就打招呼。“喜弟，你们这是上哪儿呢？”“呃，去宇宁家，来了客人。”徐喜弟努力保持如常，像从前一样和刘烨说话。可耳根还是热热的，低着头，也不太敢跟他对视。连续亲热了三个晚上，她怎么还能做到若无其事？尤其昨晚，这个五大三粗的糙汉，那样的温柔缠绵……徐喜弟最终还是忍不住把视线转到他的那双唇上，被吮了一夜，此刻竟还异常地红润。隐隐能看到肿了一圈。妈耶！昨夜自己是多用力？想到这，徐喜弟羞得整张脸刷红。刘烨定定看着她，神色十分复杂，“宇宁表亲来了吗？”他也有些不知道自己在说什么，此刻只想多和她说几句话。“嗯，表兄妹三个都来了，他妹妹也带着娃来了。”徐喜弟不自在极了，想快点结束对话，然后逃跑。“原来他说的是真的。”刘烨咕哝了一句，看来今晚的酒是喝不成了。“叔你这个时间出去，准备上哪儿呢？”“我去那个山头开一片地，打发打发时间。”“开荒地吗？”这几年村里劳动力富余的人家，会在空闲的时候开一些荒地。刘烨这个饭桶，多开一些荒地，才有可能吃饱饭，这个徐喜弟理解。“对，反正一身力气放着也是放着。”刘烨憨笑起来。一身力气……听到这几个字，徐喜弟就忍不住往歪了想。这个壮牛的一身力气，她已经有了切实的体验。可是他指的那个山头，离村近是近，但石头多，山又高。开出来的地块大大小小的，耕种起来不方便。还是给这个傻大个指一条路吧！“叔，那个山头不好。你听我的，去村东边，小羊山，那里只有杂草，树只有小丛，开荒最合适。”“小羊山？可是那里土不肥。”刘烨摇摇头，不认同。大家都知道那座山不肥，所以没人愿意去那里开。“土不肥，可是它一大片的，你开了它，整座山都是你自己的地。家里不是养了牛，前两年舍得下肥，很快就养起来了。”徐喜弟提出自己的见解，“与其东一块西一块，不如集中到一个山头，方便耕种打理。”“我都想过去那里开土，你不去的话，等秋收完，我也要去开的。”“不不不，你别去，你家就两个女劳动力。你想要那个山头，叔去帮你占着。”刘烨一听徐喜弟想去开荒，连忙阻止，她可不适合做这种体力活。“昂？”徐喜弟愣了，傻叔说的啥？他去帮她开荒？“不，不用。叔，你先开自己的。那么大一个山头，开了我家现在也没有人力去种……”“那不是小事吗，叔帮你们家先种起来，等以后你方便了，再拿去。”刘烨想也不想，就提出了一个自认为最恰当的方案。“叔，不能这样……”徐喜弟再次被刘烨的憨傻惊住。她就是那么一说，生完孩子她就要走的，开什么荒，种什么地？“不打紧，不打紧，叔有的是力气！就这么说定了，我今天就先去给你占山头。”刘烨不由分说，就拐了个方向，摆摆手，眨眼的功夫走得不见人影。徐喜弟无奈地摇摇头。行吧，让他去开，她以后走了，山头也只会是他的。
content_en: "Here, have an orange." Wang Aimian took a green-skinned orange and handed it to Xu Xidi."It's not yet ripe, but it's still edible. We young people all love this bite. I picked a small bag from the tree." Xu Xidi took it without any courtesy and started peeling it. When she had just finished peeling it, Liu Yuning suddenly snatched it away."I don't have nails, so it's not easy to peel them off. Let me try this first." Xu Xidi was stunned for a moment, and then glared at him angrily, "You also know that the skin is hard to peel off, so grab mine!" Hahaha... Several young people laughed together, so happy.Wang Aimian handed another one over, "There's more, don't worry..." Wang Xiuju walked back and forth between the fire room and the main room, her eyes always looking at the two figures that were close to each other.After the eighth round trip, she finally found a suitable excuse, "Yuning, I saw your sister taking your nephew to the entrance of the village. Go and pick her up." As soon as Liu Yuning heard that her sister was back and she was taking her nephew with her, she quickly stood up and said, "Are you there?" Xu Xidi saw that it was almost time and they would have lunch if they didn't leave. She also stood up and pulled Sister Ba'er."Brother Yuning, it's time for me to go back and make lunch. Aimian, you can come to my house later when you are free." "Okay, I'll go there after lunch." Wang Aimian also stood up and wanted to see Xu Xidi off, but politely asked, "How about we have lunch together and then go back?" "No, the elders in the family are still waiting, and they don't know." Xu Xidi didn't dare to stay to eat, and Wang Xiuju's face was so dark.Sister Ba'er, however, froze and refused to move, staring intently at the load of three-color glutinous rice.Xu Xidi's face turned red with embarrassment. Her eldest aunt's embarrassing behavior made her feel ashamed.Wang Aimian could also see that Sister Ba'er wanted to eat glutinous rice, but when the food was delivered to her aunt's house, she could not distribute it at will.The corner of Wang Xiuju's mouth twitched. Her parents came in carrying a load. In front of them, she couldn't just dig out a piece.The etiquette cannot be touched until the guests leave. This is the rule.Wang Aimian had no choice but to grab a few more candies and give two oranges to Sister Ba'er to ease the embarrassing situation.But Sister Ba'er just wanted to eat glutinous rice. She had candy in her hand, but she still couldn't move her feet.Finally, Liu Yuning went to grab a large ball of glutinous rice from the load and handed it to Xu Xidi."It looks delicious. Let's take it back and try it." Xu Xidi's old face was already red to the top of his ears. If he had known she would not come this time, it would be a shame!But she could only take it bravely. With it, Sister Ba'er immediately smiled happily and followed her back to the hospital and home....and left Liu's house as if running away. Xu Xidi looked at the big ball of glutinous rice in his hand and really wanted to throw it into the grass.But she couldn't. Firstly, she couldn't waste the food. Secondly, Sister Ba'er would definitely have to turn back and go back to ask for another round.On the way home, after passing a fork in the road, Liu Ye was about to leave the village carrying a handful of trampled pears, a nail hoe, and a big hatchet on his waist.When he saw Xu Xidi and Sister Ba'er, he stopped and said hello from a distance."Xidi, where are you going?" "Uh, I'm going to Yuning's house. There are guests." Xu Xidi tried his best to remain normal and talked to Liu Ye as before.But the base of his ears was still hot, and he lowered his head, not daring to look at him.After being intimate for three nights in a row, how could she still act as if nothing had happened?Especially last night, this big and thick rough man was so gentle and lingering... Xu Xidi finally couldn't help but turn her eyes to his lips, which were still unusually rosy at this moment after being sucked on them all night.A slight swelling can be seen.Oh my god!How hard did you exert yourself last night?Thinking of this, Xu Xidi's face turned red with embarrassment.Liu Ye looked at her steadily, with a very complicated expression on his face, "Is cousin Yuning here?" He also didn't know what he was talking about. At this moment, he just wanted to say a few more words to her."Well, the three cousins ​​are here, and his sister is also here with her baby." Xu Xidi felt extremely uncomfortable and wanted to end the conversation quickly and run away."It turns out what he said is true." Liu Ye muttered. It seemed that he couldn't drink enough wine tonight."Uncle, where are you going when you go out at this time?" "I'm going to open a piece of land on that hilltop to pass the time." "Opening up wasteland?" In recent years, families with a surplus of labor in the village will open up some wasteland in their free time.Xu Xidi understands that Liu Ye, a food-basket, needs to open up more wasteland so that he can have enough to eat."Yes, it's okay to put all your strength into it anyway." Liu Ye laughed naively.With all his strength... Hearing these words, Xu Xidi couldn't help but think about it.She had already experienced the strength of this strong bull.But the hill he pointed to was close to the village, but there were many rocks and the mountain was high.The plots opened are large and small, making it inconvenient to cultivate.Let's show this stupid guy a way out!"Uncle, that hilltop is not good. You listen to me and go to Xiaoyang Mountain to the east of the village. There are only weeds and small clumps of trees there. It is the most suitable place to open up wasteland." "Little Yangshan? But the soil there is not fertile." Liu Ye shook his head and disagreed.Everyone knows that the mountain is not fertile, so no one wants to drive there."The soil is not fertile, but it is a large area. If you cultivate it, the whole mountain will be your own land. The family raised cattle, and they were willing to fertilize them in the first two years, and they were raised quickly." Xu Xidi put forward his own opinion, "Instead of spreading them here and there, it is better to concentrate them on one hilltop for easier farming and management.""I want to go over there to open up land. If you don't go, I will do it after the autumn harvest is over." "No, no, no, don't go, your family only has two female laborers. If you want that hilltop, uncle will help you occupy it." When Liu Ye heard that Xu Xidi wanted to open up land, he quickly stopped him. She was not suitable for such manual work."Ang?" Xu Xidi was stunned. What did Uncle Silly say?Is he going to help her open up wasteland?"No, no need. Uncle, you plant your own first. It's such a big mountain, and my family doesn't have the manpower to plant it now..." "Isn't that a small matter? I will help your family plant it first, and then take it away when it is convenient for you." Without thinking, Liu Ye proposed a plan that he thought was the most appropriate."Uncle, you can't do this..." Xu Xidi was once again shocked by Liu Ye's stupidity.That's what she said. She would leave after giving birth. What kind of wasteland would be opened and what kind of land would be planted?"It doesn't matter, it doesn't matter, I have plenty of strength! It's settled, I will go and occupy the top of the mountain for you today." Liu Ye couldn't help but turn around, waved his hand, and disappeared in the blink of an eye.Xu Xidi shook his head helplessly.Okay, let him drive. After she leaves, the hilltop will only be his.
